# Utkarsh Gupta — Full-Stack Developer & AI Architect

> Full-stack developer and AI architect based in Bhopal, India. Specializes in React, Next.js, Python, Go, WebRTC, and scalable real-time systems.

## About

Utkarsh Gupta is a B.Tech Computer Science student at LNCT Group of Colleges, Bhopal. He builds production-ready AI platforms, high-performance streaming architectures, and real-time communication systems. His work spans frontend engineering (React, Next.js), backend systems (Node.js, FastAPI, Go), AI/ML (LLMs, PyTorch), and real-time infrastructure (WebRTC, WebSockets, Redis).

## Projects

- [Meowly](https://meowly.qzz.io): Modern anime and TV streaming platform built with Next.js and TypeScript with adaptive bitrate delivery.
- [GitDude](https://pypi.org/project/gitdude): AI-powered CLI tool converting natural language to Git actions with multi-LLM support. Published on PyPI.
- [CodeFlux](https://github.com/utkarshgupta188/codeflux): Intelligent AI routing gateway for autonomous agentic code analysis and management.
- [Omiro](https://github.com/utkarshgupta188/omiro): Scalable real-time chat and WebRTC video matching system using Go, Redis, and microservices.
- [Dora Music](https://dora-music.vercel.app): Web-based music player with Glassmorphism UI and infinite radio streaming.
- [Meow CLI](https://pypi.org/project/meowtv): Terminal-based streaming client for browsing and watching content from the command line.
- [MindMate](https://github.com/utkarshgupta188/mindmate): Mental wellness companion powered by local LLMs for private conversations.
- [tgupload](https://github.com/utkarshgupta188/tgupload): Zero-cost cloud storage leveraging Telegram infrastructure with FastAPI backend.
- [Attendance Tracker](https://lnctu.vercel.app): API using BeautifulSoup to scrape subject-wise university attendance data.
- [MeowTV](https://meowtv.qzz.io): Live TV and on-demand movie streaming platform.
